sections.heading: SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Software QA Team Lead== and test automation architect with [confirm total years]+ years leading quality engineering for SaaS, developer-tooling, and automotive-retail platforms. Owns frameworks covering **9,000+ automated test cases** and built a Docker Swarm-based Selenium Grid executing **3,500+ tests daily**. Combines QA team leadership, test strategy, REST API testing, CI/CD, and hands-on automation with Selenium, Java, JavaScript / Node.js, Ruby, Cypress, and Cucumber.

==Define test strategy and effort estimates== for manual, automation, and REST API testing in partnership with engineering squads.
Established organization-wide automation guidelines and review gates adopted by [team count] teams, strengthening quality standards across multiple squads.

Developed a custom Node.js framework validating **200+ enterprise REST API endpoints daily**.
Identified critical security vulnerabilities in PushCrew during the internal Hack Your Own Code programme.
